findings.detail: Package execution uses the --pa-entry path at lines131/161, but collectEntries reports --review-entry/--start-entry or the default apps/launcher/bin/pa.mjs. findings.detail: The package branch copies instance.pid but its identity.bound predicate checks only state, startupMode and digest, and never requires a live PID/start/config/operation serving identity. A unique missing-PID mutation of an otherwise accepted private package protocol returns verified-flow, verified:true, identity.recordPid:null, identity.bound:true. Actual installed start has not been measured by C, so source identity passes must not be generalized to this branch.

findings.detail: finalizeCleanup records a failed stop or catches an error but final status/verified/exitCode remain successful. Changing only the private package stop command from exit0 to exit1 retains verified-flow/exit0 with cleanup.owned:true, cleanup.stopped:false. The source catch path likewise stores cleanup failure without changing a successful main result. Reused or explicitly kept instances are a distinct lawful case and must remain untouched.
findings.next: An owned resource required to stop must produce an explicit cleanup failure and nonzero flow result if it remains live/unknown. Preserve its state and ownership facts; independently verify exact instance exit rather than only CLI exit0.

findings.detail: prepareReview uses a fixed30000ms spawnSync timeout and restoredReviewIdentity uses a fixed10000ms helper timeout, independent of the declared overall deadline. remainingDeliveryGaps.detail: The verifier rebuilds commands/dispatch from the supplied manifest's own lists. Removing all original commands, changing counts and recomputing the ordinary digest still verifies. If selected-subset output is intentional, it must say so; this does not prove a complete expected original command/unknown set. Use an independently bound producer specification or explicit coverage, not self-selected empty lists.
